_notes.initialToolUsesM6: The firmware ignores tool length offsets without an M6 before the first motion.
_notes.toolLengthComp: Carvera's MTC probes every tool against the fixed setter (M491) and the ATC probes internally on M6. Both own Z; a G43 over a probed offset double-applies it.
_notes.rotary: The Carvera rotary (A) exists, but its firmware's feed handling for mixed X/A moves is UNVERIFIED and no G93 is documented: inverseTime stays false and 'wrapped-linear' leads. Confirm against the machine before promoting a-word. indexDwell suits a belt rotary; Machine Settings overrides it.
_notes.defaults: generateFooter() emits the whole M5, retract, G28 park, M30 sequence itself. A default endCode would run AFTER G28 and drive the machine back out of the ATC park position.
